entities.summary: DaQuan Marquel Jeffries is an American professional basketball player for the Sacramento Kings of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Oral Roberts Golden Eagles, Western Texas Westerners, and Tulsa Golden Hurricane.
